crossRefs.note: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel…

parallels.note: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones.…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.
translations.bsb: So the Israelites did this, sending such people outside the camp. They did just as the LORD had instructed Moses.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp; as Jehovah spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
